name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Shows tokens per second for the current conversation in the ZCode Desktop composer. Requires ZCode 3.18.2 or later. Includes /tps, a multi-session dashboard, and MCP tools.

description_i18n.en: Shows tokens per second for the current conversation in the ZCode Desktop composer. Requires ZCode 3.18.2 or later. Includes /tps, a multi-session dashboard, and MCP tools.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 ZCode 桌面端输入框底部显示当前会话的 tok/s。要求 ZCode 3.18.2 或更高版本，另提供 /tps、多会话大屏和 MCP 工具。

title.zh-CN: 打开 TPS 监控面板

metrics_url.title: Metrics URL
metrics_url.description: HTTP 接口地址，返回包含 tps/qps 字段的 JSON；留空则使用演示数据。
